name: Bitcoin
reason: Prioritizes maximal security and censorship resistance over throughput for a settlement-focused network.

name: Ethereum
reason: Moved from PoW to PoS to cut energy use by ~99.9% while preserving broad validator decentralization.

name: EOS
reason: Chose DPoS to hit high throughput for consumer-facing applications with sub-second confirmation.

name: TRON
reason: Uses a 27-witness DPoS model to support high-volume content and payment dApps.

name: VeChain
reason: Enterprise supply-chain use cases favor known, accountable validators over full decentralization.

name: BNB Smart Chain
reason: Combines PoA-style authority validators with staking for fast, low-cost EVM compatibility.

name: Hyperledger Fabric
reason: Enterprise consortiums need immediate, deterministic finality among known participants.

name: Cosmos Hub
reason: Tendermint BFT gives the Cosmos ecosystem instant finality and interchain security guarantees.

name: BNB Beacon Chain
reason: Adopted Tendermint for fast, final settlement of native token transfers.

name: Avalanche C-Chain
reason: Novel sampling-based consensus supports thousands of validators with sub-second finality.

name: Solana
reason: Proof of History timestamps transactions before voting, enabling extremely high raw throughput.

name: Chia
reason: Designed as a 'green' alternative to PoW mining by repurposing spare storage capacity.

name: Burstcoin (Signum)
reason: One of the earliest chains to trade computation for disk storage via Proof of Capacity.

name: Counterparty
reason: Bootstrapped its asset layer by burning Bitcoin to fairly distribute initial supply.

name: Slimcoin
reason: Combines PoW, PoS, and PoB to explore burn-based long-term miner commitment.

name: Hyperledger Sawtooth
reason: Uses Intel SGX-based PoET for energy-efficient consensus among enterprise participants.

name: Dogecoin
reason: Merge-mined PoW secured by Litecoin's hash power, with checkpoint-style finality practices.

name: Decred
reason: Explicitly hybridizes PoW block production with PoS voting to checkpoint and govern the chain.

name: Polygon PoS
reason: Runs a PoS checkpoint layer that periodically commits state back to Ethereum for security.

name: Algorand
reason: Pure PoS with cryptographic sortition delivers fast finality without energy-intensive mining.
